name: RIVAROXABAN 20 MG 28 TABLETS LOVENTRAX
description: Rivaroxaban is a blood thinning medication used to prevent blood clots and reduce the risk of stroke, especially in people with atrial fibrillation (irregular heartbeat). It is also used to treat and prevent deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE). If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
